The '''Valorsi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Valorsi]].
